Notice under Section 7

I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act,that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a Rambakenoya Project:- Description of the land to be acquired:

Allotments of Land in P. P. MO 272 Sheet No. 56/9/2/ (J 19/28) Prepared by the Superintend Surveyor in Moneragala, Situated in Damanegama Villge in the Madulla Divisional Secretariy’s Division of the District of Moneragala in Uva Province described as follows.
1. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Kabaragalawella and Naranwattha; Claimant: State; Encrocher: H. M. Chamila Dilrukshi Nelliyadda; Extent: 0.8094 Hectare.
